# Automated Search

End-to-end literature search pipeline: pick a PubMed query, get a fully-merged
source RIS file for the visualizer and a folder of PDFs synced to both Google
Drive and Cloudflare R2 — with a self-contained, timestamped record of every
run.

See [SCHEMA.md](SCHEMA.md) for the on-disk contract of each run folder, and the
plan at `.cursor/plans/automated-search-recordkeeping_10a08f2d.plan.md` for the
phasing/acceptance criteria of this refactor.

## Quickstart

```bash
export LIT_REVIEW_PDF_REMOTE="gdrive:nlp_lit_review_1_papers/pdfs"
export NCBI_EMAIL="you@example.com"
export NCBI_API_KEY="<optional but recommended>"

python3 automated_search/scripts/auto_search_wrapper.py \
    --query '("Large Language Models"[tiab]) AND ("Extraction"[tiab])' \
    --slug nlp_extraction \
    --label '( NLP extraction )'
```

That command:

1. Bootstraps `automated_search/searches/<ts>__nlp_extraction/` with
   `metadata.json`, `input.ris`, `found/`, `missing/`, log/progress files.
2. Fetches the PubMed query via NCBI E-utilities into `input.ris`.
3. Runs V4 (Selenium) to download PDFs into `$LIT_REVIEW_PDF_STORE/pdfs/`
   (content-addressable, keyed by PMID/DOI/title hash) with relative symlinks
   under `<run>/found/pdfs/`.
4. Routes `<run>/found/found.ris` through Step 1 (absolute paths) and Step 2
   (RN-label stamping from `metadata.search_term_label`, no historical-tree scan).
5. Merges into the visualizer's source RIS (O(N) dict lookup with mtime-keyed cache).
6. Writes `<run>/summary.md`.
7. Mirrors the PDF store to Cloudflare R2 with `rclone sync --progress`.

## Refresh all catalog searches

To re-run **every** configured PubMed query end-to-end (Entrez fetch, full V4 PDF scrape,
merge into `visualizer_nlp_lit_review/RIS_source_files/`, and end-of-run R2 sync unless disabled),
use the batch driver. Catalog entries live in `visualizer_nlp_lit_review/config.py` inside
`COMMON_SEARCH_TERMS`: each entry that includes non-empty `query`, `slug`, and `label` is
included. Add or adjust those three fields whenever you add a live search so automation and
the visualizer stay aligned.

Set the same environment variables as in Quickstart (`NCBI_EMAIL`, `LIT_REVIEW_PDF_REMOTE` or
`LIT_REVIEW_PDF_STORE`, optional `NCBI_API_KEY`). Then from the **repository root**:

```bash
python3 automated_search/scripts/refresh_catalog.py
```

Preview commands without running:

```bash
python3 automated_search/scripts/refresh_catalog.py --dry-run
```

If one search fails, the default is to stop immediately. To finish the rest and report failures:

```bash
python3 automated_search/scripts/refresh_catalog.py --continue-on-error
```

Each run creates a **new** timestamped folder under `automated_search/searches/`. After a
successful batch, commit and push updates under `visualizer_nlp_lit_review/RIS_source_files/`
for the deployed site to pick up the merged RIS.

## Environment variables

| name | required? | purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `LIT_REVIEW_PDF_REMOTE` | **preferred** | rclone remote path for the PDF store (e.g. `gdrive:nlp_lit_review_1_papers/pdfs`). No FUSE mount needed — V4 uploads each PDF directly after download. **Use this on macOS 26+ where macFUSE is not yet supported.** |
| `LIT_REVIEW_PDF_STORE` | alternative | Absolute local path to a FUSE-mounted Google Drive folder (legacy mount mode). Set this instead of `LIT_REVIEW_PDF_REMOTE` only if you have a working `rclone mount`. |
| `NCBI_EMAIL` | when using `--query` | NCBI ToS requires a contact email. |
| `NCBI_API_KEY` | recommended | Higher Entrez rate limits. |
| `LIT_REVIEW_R2_REMOTE` | no | Override the R2 destination (default `r2:nlp-lit-review-pdfs`). |
| `LIT_REVIEW_GDRIVE_REMOTE` | no | Override the gdrive source when syncing to R2 via `--remote-source` (default `gdrive:nlp_lit_review_1_papers/pdfs`). |
| `LIT_REVIEW_AUTO_R2_SYNC` | no | Set to `0` to skip the end-of-run R2 sync (default: enabled). |
| `ZOTERO_PASS_DIR` | no | Legacy labeler fallback path. Only used under `--legacy`. |

## rclone setup (one-time)

Already configured in this environment (`rclone listremotes` shows `gdrive:`
and `r2:`). For a fresh machine:

```bash
brew install rclone
rclone config        # add gdrive: and r2: interactively
```

R2 is configured as an S3-compatible remote (provider `Cloudflare R2`,
endpoint `<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`). The visualizer reads PDFs from
this bucket; the auto-sync at end-of-run keeps it identical to Google Drive.

> **macOS 26+ note**: `rclone mount` (FUSE) is not yet compatible with macOS 26.
> Use `$LIT_REVIEW_PDF_REMOTE` (rclone-copy mode) — no mount needed.
> V4 downloads each PDF to a small local temp folder, copies it to Google Drive
> via `rclone copy`, then deletes the local copy immediately. Local disk usage
> per paper is < 50 MB at any instant.

## Common invocations

```bash
python3 automated_search/scripts/auto_search_wrapper.py \
    --input-ris ~/Downloads/pubmed_export.ris \
    --slug nlp_extraction --label '( NLP extraction )'
```

```bash
python3 automated_search/scripts/auto_search_wrapper.py \
    --found-ris path/to/found.ris \
    --slug nlp_extraction --label '( NLP extraction )'
```

```bash
python3 automated_search/scripts/auto_search_wrapper.py \
    --query '...' --slug x --label '(x)' --dry-run
```

```bash
python3 automated_search/scripts/auto_search_wrapper.py \
    --resume automated_search/searches/2026_05_14_154732__nlp_extraction
```

```bash
python3 automated_search/scripts/sync_pdfs_to_r2.py
python3 automated_search/scripts/sync_pdfs_to_r2.py --dry-run
python3 automated_search/scripts/sync_pdfs_to_r2.py --remote-source
```

```bash
python3 automated_search/scripts/auto_search_wrapper.py --legacy
```

## Run folder layout

See [SCHEMA.md](SCHEMA.md) for the full contract. The short version:

```
automated_search/searches/2026_05_14_154732__nlp_extraction/
  metadata.json     <- tracked
  summary.md        <- tracked
  input.ris         <- gitignored
  found/found.ris   <- gitignored
  found/pdfs/       <- gitignored; symlinks into $LIT_REVIEW_PDF_STORE/pdfs/
  missing/still_missing.ris  <- gitignored
  progress.jsonl    <- gitignored; one line per attempted record (powers --resume)
  errors.jsonl      <- gitignored; subset of progress with failure reasons
  log.txt           <- gitignored; full V4 stdout/stderr
```

## Tests

```bash
python3 -m pytest automated_search/tests/ -v
```

46 tests covering slug normalization, run-folder allocation with collision
handling, metadata schema accept/reject, content-addressable store helpers,
the explicit-label stamper, and the bootstrap end-to-end against the
5-reference fixture.

## Troubleshooting

- **`PdfStoreUnavailable`**: neither `$LIT_REVIEW_PDF_REMOTE` nor
  `$LIT_REVIEW_PDF_STORE` is set, or the rclone remote/mount is unreachable.
  For macOS 26+ use `export LIT_REVIEW_PDF_REMOTE="gdrive:nlp_lit_review_1_papers/pdfs"`.
- **rclone-copy mode: `WARNING: rclone upload failed`**: the paper was
  downloaded locally but the upload to Google Drive failed.  Local copy remains
  in `automated_search/.tmp_pdfs/<run_id>/`.  Fix connectivity and re-upload
  manually with `rclone copy <file> gdrive:nlp_lit_review_1_papers/pdfs`, then
  delete the local copy.
- **`mid-run health check failed`** (mount mode only): V4 detected a stale
  mount mid-scrape and refused to proceed. Re-mount and `--resume` the run
  folder.
- **`Entrez fetch requires biopython`**: `pip install biopython`.
- **`NCBI requires an email address`**: `export NCBI_EMAIL=you@example.com`.
- **`SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED` on Entrez**: common on macOS or university
  networks with SSL inspection. In the admin GUI, enable **Insecure SSL for NCBI**,
  or `export LIT_REVIEW_ENTREZ_INSECURE_SSL=1`. Alternatively set
  `LIT_REVIEW_SSL_CA_BUNDLE` to your institution's root CA `.pem`, or run Apple's
  `Install Certificates.command` for your Python install.
- **R2 sync failed at end of run**: the run otherwise succeeded.
  `metadata.r2_synced_at` is left null; re-run
  `python3 automated_search/scripts/sync_pdfs_to_r2.py --run <run>` once R2 is
  reachable.

## Legacy mode

`--legacy` preserves the pre-refactor interactive workflow that reads/writes
`missing_papers/` and `found_papers/`. It exists for one-off back-compat
runs and is removed in Phase 7 of the refactor (after the acceptance criteria
in the plan pass). The historical SOP is preserved at
`archive/SOP_Paper_Scrape_v1.txt`.
